title: Can't sleep after scrolling in bed? Try 4-7-8 breathing before the next video.

copy.instagram_caption:
Can't sleep after scrolling in bed? Try 4-7-8 breathing before the next video.

The feed keeps your mind busy, so your body never gets the cue to wind down.

In for 4. Hold for 7. Out for 8. Two to four rounds is plenty. If the hold makes you lightheaded, skip it and make the exhale long.

Save this for tonight.

DeRot pauses your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths. Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
